messages.author: e41e918f74a5db50
messages.subject: Special character in label
parts:
Dear All,

In the following code:

ggplot(auc, aes(var, fstudy)) + geom_point(aes(shape = formul),size =
3) +
geom_text(aes(label=as.character(var)),color="blue",hjust=1.4,
vjust=0,size=3.5)+
xlab(expression(paste(AUC[0-24] ," (", mu, "g.h/mL)",sep=""))) +
ylab("Study") + scale_shape("Formulation")+
geom_text(aes(x=xlab,label=finding),size=3, vjust=1.5)


I plot labels in geom_text wich are in variate finding (last line) which
content comes from a CSV file.

In these labels, instead of "increase", for example, I would like to
have the special character up arrow (\2191 if I am not mistaken).

I have read the doc for plotmath but I still don't see how to make this
work . For example having label=expression(finding) does not work and
putting symbol("\2191") does not either.

Thanks for any help.

Best wishes, JL
